name: Akatsuki (暁, "Daybreak")
concept: A Witchwarper-class Frame that answers Masaru's exacting precision with something stranger — a battlefield-warping cantrip reflavored at Frame scale as tearing a seam in the fight itself, not throwing a punch. The one part of him that isn't careful.
notes: DRAFT — proposed 2026-08-22 at Ingram's direct request, open to full revision. Grounded in GM Core pg. 121-126's real level-12 tables: AC Low (30) and HP Low (160) — 'low AC typically fits spellcasters, who compensate with their selection of powerful spells' — paired with High-tier spell DC/attack (32/+24, GM Core pg. 126, the same tier Tsukikage's Mystic uses, for a consistent 'primary caster' baseline across both spellcasting Frames). Quantum Shear's own damage (6d8, avg 27) is NOT independently pack-extracted the way Tsukikage's Eldritch Lance/Transfer Vitality are (that content came from a real Foundry pregen; Witchwarper's real signature spell wasn't separately researched this pass) — it's a representative, class-flavored placeholder sized to land in the same rough range as a real SF2E cantrip at this level (Eldritch Lance's own real printed damage at rank 6 is 7d6, avg 24.5 — spells trade raw damage for versatility compared to an equivalent weapon Strike, and this follows that same real pattern rather than inventing a bigger number). Mechanically an attack-roll spell (reuses the same spellAttack engine path Tsukikage does) even though its NAME leans into Witchwarper's real battlefield-control identity — a genuinely save-based control spell would need a new engine action type (resolveSave/basicSaveDamage exist in resolve.mjs but aren't wired to a proposal type yet) that wasn't built this pass; flagged as a real next step, not silently glossed over.
